description_for_human: Free professional calculators for finance, health, home, unit conversion and more. 23 calculators, 76 conversion pairs, 47 currencies, 9 languages.
description_for_model: TrufflShuffl provides free online calculators for financial (loan, mortgage, investment, VAT, ROI, savings, retirement, salary, percentage), health (BMI, calories, age), home (pool, paint, paving, renovation), fuel, fashion (clothing/shoe/belt/ring size), and unit conversion (76 pairs: length, weight, temperature, area, volume, speed, time, data, pressure, energy, power). All calculations are client-side JavaScript. Conversion pages follow the URL pattern /{lang}/convert/{from}-to-{to}/{value}. Data available at /api/v1/. LLM instructions at /llms.txt.
